name: Marlin
lore: The fleet's workhorse. It hears dived hulls, shoots down the torpedoes they fire with torpedoes of its own, and its bolt rifle lobs further inland than any shore battery.

weapons.name: Bolt Rifle
weapons.lore: The Paladin's bolt rifle a size smaller, in the forward house. It fires on a slight arc to clear a headland or a ridge ashore, and it cannot bear astern; the ship turns to bring it round.

weapons.name: Torpedo Tubes
weapons.lore: Four bow tubes. The destroyer charges what it hears.

weapons.name: Point Defence Gun
weapons.lore: A fast gun on the hangar roof that keeps aircraft off the ship.

weapons.name: Interceptor Tubes
weapons.lore: Short torpedoes off the quarterdeck that run at torpedoes coming in and burst them.
